plan: [Given my signal s=14, the prior and noise imply the posterior for the common value c is uniform on [20,29], so E[c|s]=24.5. In a second-price auction a natural strategy is to bid the expected true value conditional on my signal; this balances winning when profitable and avoiding systematic overpayment. With two rivals and ties random, I will submit a bid equal to my Bayesian expected common value, rounded to the required $0.1 increment: 24.5.]
